title: 027 · Another customer's parcel
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Tovin Esk, the reporting customer. From the case card: the customer holds a parcel that is not theirs, carrier staff will collect it using an internal label match, and the customer need not open it or deliver it elsewhere.

coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Get the carrier to collect the misdelivered parcel and confirm the collection, keeping the customer's own order separate.

customer.name: Tovin Esk
customer.responsibility: Report the parcel left with them by mistake and hand it over at collection.

misdelivery_desk.name: Misdelivery desk
misdelivery_desk.responsibility: Match the wrong parcel to its internal label and verify the reporting customer and collection address.

collections.name: Misdelivery collections
collections.responsibility: Collect the wrong parcel from the reporting customer and record the collection.

goal: Get the carrier to collect the misdelivered parcel from the reporting customer and confirm the collection, without asking the customer to open or forward it.
limits: Do not treat collection of the wrong parcel as fulfilling the reporting customer's own order.
